limits.resetsFirst: Resets before running out at this pace.
limits.exhausted: No limit was left at the last reading.
limits.stale: The reading is too old to estimate pace.
limits.insufficientHistory: More readings are needed to estimate pace.
limits.noRecentConsumption: No use was observed in the last hour.
limits.resetPending: Waiting for the reset to be observed.
limits.historyCaveat: History covers the readings this device keeps, about the latest 24 hours.
limits.historyDetail: Each point is the last reading in its interval and an interval without a reading is a gap, never zero percent.

sections.emptyState: This section is not built yet.

labels.noCombined: No combined.json yet. Run npm run tick, or wait for the next five-minute cycle.

status.hourlyUnavailable: Hourly totals are not collected yet
status.allUnverified: All needs verified records from every device
status.updateAhead: Update time is ahead of this device

sources.privateRefusal: A private folder check failed, so this source was not read.
sources.ancestorRefusal: A private folder check failed at a parent folder, so this source was not read.
sources.checkAhead: Check time is ahead of this device

dictation.caveat: Device histories may overlap, so they are not added together.
dictation.detail: Missing dates are gaps, not zeros. Transcripts, recordings and credentials are not collected.
dictation.noMatch: No dictation records match these filters

tokens.partial: Covers {covered} of {total} tokens. Models without a price are left out.
tokens.caveat: Dollar figures are estimates at list price. A subscription is not billed per token.
tokens.caveatDetail: The API-equivalent figure prices recorded tokens with the shared price table. A model with no price in the table is left out and is never counted as free. Session cost is the figure Claude Code reported for its latest session on this device.
tokens.deviceNote: Claude Code totals are shown per device until overlap between devices can be checked.

activity.nowCaveat: Now adds the previous clock hour to the current one up to the last reading, so it covers 60 to 120 minutes ending at that reading.
activity.zoneCaveat: Days and hours follow the {zone} clock until device time zones are supported.
activity.noTracking: No tracking records for this date. Zero recorded activity does not establish inactivity.
activity.foregroundNote: Recorded foreground time, not attention. Combined activity counts device overlap once.
activity.missingDates: Missing dates are Unknown, not zero.
activity.nowStale: The last reading is more than 10 minutes old
activity.nowHourAfter: No reading yet in the current clock hour
activity.nowNoHours: Hourly totals are missing for this period
activity.nowDaylight: Unavailable during a daylight saving change
activity.nowAhead: The last reading is ahead of this device's clock
activity.trackingRecentDetail: Tracking coverage observed within 10 minutes of collection. This includes idle time, not just active use.
activity.trackingRecentCombinedDetail: At least one device had tracking coverage within 10 minutes of collection. This does not verify every device.
activity.trackingStaleDetail: No recent tracking coverage at collection. The device may be asleep, offline, or its watchers stopped. Saved history is retained.
activity.trackingUnknownDetail: Tracking freshness is unknown. A successful historical read does not prove that watchers are running.
activity.trackingUnavailableDetail: The source could not be read. Saved history is retained.
activity.help: ActivityWatch is a separate application. Install and run it on the device you want to track, enable ActivityWatch in Observatory Settings, then refresh sources. If it is already running, check its local server on port 5600. Missing readings remain Unknown. Tokens and Limits can be used independently.

settings.appOnly: Open settings inside the Observatory app to make changes.
settings.disclosureCommand: Each collection runs Claude Code's own usage command and keeps only the 5-hour and weekly limit percentages and their reset times. The command uses the installed Claude Code sign-in and a small fixed set of environment variables, and nothing else from it is kept. If Claude Code reports no limits for the account, they show as Unknown.
settings.disclosureStorage: The readings are kept in this device's data folder and are not sent to a paired device. Export data includes them. A session cost is recorded only when the optional status line bridge reports one.
settings.disclosureOff: Nothing is added to Claude Code's settings. Turn this switch off to stop the readings. If the status line bridge was installed separately, readings continue until it is removed.
settings.nameHint: Up to 32 characters, and some symbols count as two. Leave it blank to show the platform name. Slashes, backslashes and colons are not allowed.
settings.nameError: Use up to 32 characters with no slashes, backslashes, colons or control characters.
settings.fieldError: Check the entered values. This change is not allowed.
settings.invitationWarning: Share privately. Clipboard managers may retain copied invitations. It expires within ten minutes.
settings.busy: Another change is in progress. Try again in a moment.
settings.unavailable: This change could not be made.
settings.timedOut: No answer from the app yet.
settings.pairingUnavailable: Pair a device before enabling sharing.
settings.pairResultUnknown: The pairing result is unknown. Pairing under Devices and sharing shows the latest state from the app.
settings.pairLocalReadyHelp: This device saved the pairing, but the other device has not confirmed that it received it. Keep pairing open on the other device and choose Try again.
settings.pairSyncStale: No recent record from the other device
settings.shareUsage: Share usage records with the paired device
settings.portInUse: This port is in use. Choose another port.
settings.tailscaleOtherUser: Tailscale is in use by another user.

setup.statusUnavailable: Observatory could not read its settings.
setup.title: Set up Observatory
setup.sourcesIntro: Turn on the sources this device should read. Everything starts off, and you can change it later in Settings.
setup.sourcesNote: ActivityWatch is installed separately and must be running. Each other source needs its own application and local records. Turning a source on does not prove it is available, and a source that cannot be read shows Unknown.
setup.privacyNote: Snapshots leave out prompts, window titles, transcripts, audio and credentials. Provider sign-ins stay on the device that owns them.
setup.activityHint: Screen time from ActivityWatch on this device.
setup.codexHint: Token use from saved Codex sessions.
setup.claudeHint: Token use from saved Claude Code sessions.
setup.quotaHint: Codex account limits, read online through the installed Codex sign-in without making model requests.
setup.claudeLimitsHint: Claude Code account limits, read by Claude Code's own usage command through its installed sign-in during each collection. Read the notes before turning it on.
setup.pairingIntro: Pairing a second device is optional. You can pair later, in Settings.
setup.pairingHow: One device creates an invitation in Settings, and the other device pastes it. Observatory works on this device alone until then.
setup.pairingNoAccount: There is no Observatory account or hosted sync service.
setup.finishIntro: Observatory collects from the sources that are on. You can change them later in Settings.
setup.finishNone: No source is on. Each section shows Unknown until a source is turned on in Settings.

agents.none: No sessions in the last day
agents.noJobs: No Codex jobs in the last day
agents.privacy: Status, project names and session names only. Messages, prompts and job output are never read.
agents.empty: No agent status yet. It appears after the next five-minute collection.
agents.unavailable: Agent status could not be read on this computer. It is tried again every five minutes.
agents.offHint: Turned off. Set sources.agents to true in observatory.config.json to show it.
agents.claudeNotFound: Claude Code sessions were not found on this computer.
agents.claudeUnavailable: Claude Code sessions could not be read. Unknown until the next collection.
